h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kavali

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kavali

items.pText: Kavali is a coastal town in the Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, a short distance from the Bay of Bengal, with a hot, humid climate and rain from the northeast monsoon. Schools, colleges and residential layouts here ask us for playground equipment. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 900 km away, and delivers it to Kavali by road.

The slide is usually the first piece a school asks for, and its height matters more than its colour or shape. We make individual slides in three heights, three feet, five feet and seven feet, and each suits a different stage of childhood. Choosing the right one keeps young children safe and older ones interested. Tell us the classes that will use the play area, and we will suggest the right mix of heights for your ground.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: As a rough guide, three-foot slides suit nursery and kindergarten children, who need a short ladder and a gentle run-out. Five-foot slides suit most primary classes, and seven-foot slides are for older children who climb ladders confidently. Each taller slide needs a longer clear run at the bottom, so check the safe play area before you choose. Tunnel and spiral versions add interest without extra height. In Kavali's coastal humidity, roto-moulded slide beds hold up better than painted metal.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Which slide height suits nursery children?
items.a: The lowest slides in our range, at three feet, suit nursery and kindergarten children. They have a short ladder and a gentle run-out, and they fit a small play area.

items.q: Do taller slides need more space?
items.a: Yes. A taller slide needs a longer clear zone at the bottom, where children land and step away. We mark this safe play area on the layout drawing for every slide.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Kavali and nearby coastal towns by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh.
